notes.decision: Translated 'she spoke through the chief archon, their Principality' — taking ϩⲙ̄ as instrumental ('through, by means of'). Hyle/Concupiscence (the implicit feminine subject) speaks through the archonic voice; the apposition 'their Principality' identifies which archon (the chief / leader of the principalities). ⲁⲛⲝⲱⲝ confirmed in accumulated vocabulary as 'principalities/leading-powers.'

ⲁⲩⲉⲓⲥ rendered as plural imperative 'Come you!' (= Sah. ⲁⲙⲏⲉⲓⲧⲛ̄). The intervening ⲙⲁ⸓ contains the editor's symbol ⸓ which I have left as-is — possibly an abbreviation marker or scribal symbol. ⲛϩⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲡⲉ taken as 'unto heaven' (ⲛ̄- directional + ⲍⲏⲓ 'into' + ⲛ̄ⲧⲡⲉ 'of heaven'); cf. parallel cosmogonic narratives where archons resolve to ascend.

ⲧⲛ̄ⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ taken as exclamation/vocative 'Our light!' (1pl possessive). ⲛ̄ⲧⲁⲥⲙⲓⲛⲉ as 1pl conjunctive 'let us fashion.' ⲛⲏⲧⲛⲉ is dative 2pl 'for yourselves' — the chief archon addresses fellow archons inclusively. The construction is unusual (1pl verb + 2pl beneficiary) and may reflect group-internal address.

Parsed as ⲛⲁϥ ⲛ̄ⲧⲟϥ ⲇⲉ ϩⲱⲱϥ — 'for him; but he himself.' The contrast is between collective archonic action and individual creator-act. ⲁⲉ = ⲇⲉ adversative; ⲛⲉϩ/ⲛ̄ⲧⲁϩ/ϩⲱⲱϩ form the standard Lyc. 'for him / he / himself' triplet.

Capitalized 'Sin' as cosmic principle per terminology guide. ⲃⲁⲃϩ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ rendered 'poured forth' — the verb (Lyc. reflex of ⲃⲱϩ/ⲃⲱⲱⲃ) suggests gushing/outpouring. The image is of Sin emanating outward, anticipating the identification with Hyle in the following clause.

Antithetical parallelism 'some in likeness, some not in likeness' — referring to the offspring begotten by the archons: some bear the likeness (of the Exalted One captured through the fruits), others do not. ⲉϩⲉⲓⲛⲉ = ⲉⲡⲉⲓⲛⲉ 'in the likeness'; the negation ⲉⲛ closes the second clause. Translation preserves the parallel structure.

Translated 'a sense-faculty and an operation' — keeping the Greek loanwords αἴσθησις and ἐνέργεια in their technical sense. The molder has placed members on the outside and inside, AND a perception-faculty AND an operative-power — the dual interior endowment that allows the body's storehouses to function.

Future relative with 3pl object suffix. Tentatively rendered 'they shall match them' from a verb of comparison/equation (cf. ⲟⲩⲱⲛⲧ 'compare'). The correspondential register of this passage (sense-organs draw external objects in, store them, produce them on demand to match interior storehouse contents) supports a verb of correspondence-establishment. Confidence moderate — could alternatively be a verb of transferring/joining.

ⲡⲁⲓⲧⲏⲧⲏⲥ = Greek αἰτητής 'one who demands/asks' — the body's recurrent appetitive demand. ⲉⲧⲱⲓⲧⲉ ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲩ 'who claims/demands them.' ⲙ̄ⲙⲁϩ tentatively 'continually' (Lyc. adverb), though could be a separate clause-tag. Renders the body's senses as servants delivering up stored material to a perpetual demander.
